title: ClearPath Standing and the Number of Instalments in Microsoft 365 Payment Arrangements
content:
The number of instalments in a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) payment arrangement follows the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services standing. The amount spread is divided into that many equal shares.

- **Six instalments.** The client holds an active ClearPath agreement that has renewed at least twice and owes nothing. Owing nothing means a balance of zero or a credit.
- **Four instalments.** The client holds an active ClearPath agreement that has renewed fewer than twice, or that owes a balance.
- **No active ClearPath agreement.** No ClearPath extension of the instalments applies.

The agreement's status, its renewal count and the balance due on it are read from the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement record.

## Decision table

| Active ClearPath agreement | Renewals of that agreement | Balance due on it | Instalments |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | zero, or a credit | 6 |
| yes | 2 or more | more than zero | 4 |
| yes | 0 or 1 | any | 4 |
| no (none, or not active) | — | — | no ClearPath extension |

## Hypothetical illustration

The amount spread is 1200.00 USD. Over six instalments one share is 200.00, and over four it is 300.00.

A client whose active agreement has renewed three times and carries a credit of 50.00 takes six instalments. If that agreement owed 50.00 instead, it would take four.
